Market Breadth

Continuous gradient, fixed thresholds bearish → bullish. Counts graded as share of universe. Inverted columns: red = bearish
Reference: flags, columns, regime definitions
THRUST 10%+ of the universe up 4% in a session, with at least 3x as many 4% risers as 4% fallers. Historically marks durable lows after a decline.
BEAR DIV Nifty makes a 20-session high but % above 50 DMA does not. Internal deterioration under a rising index. Often precedes a correction.
BULL DIV Nifty makes a 20-session low but % above 50 DMA does not. Internal improvement under a falling index. Marks accumulation.
% above DMA Share of stocks whose adjusted close sits above their simple moving average. 50 DMA is the primary regime gauge.
MA structure (10>20, 20>50, 50>200) Share of stocks whose shorter-term MA sits above the longer. Measures trend stacking, slower and cleaner than raw percent-above.
Net 4% Stocks up 4%+ minus stocks down 4%+, close to close. Positive = more strong movers on the buy side.
Up/Dn 25% 1M Stocks that moved 25%+ in 21 trading sessions. Measures range expansion beyond daily noise.
52w H / 52w L Adjusted close at or within 0.1% of the 250-session extreme. Click the cell to see the stock names.
Regime: broad uptrend >60% above 50 DMA. Most stocks in intermediate uptrends.
Regime: narrowing 45-60% above 50 DMA. Participation fading. Watch for bear divergences.
Regime: corrective 25-45% above 50 DMA. Mixed. Selective, not directional.
Regime: distribution 12-25% above 50 DMA. Broad selling. Risk-off.
Regime: washed out <12% above 50 DMA. Oversold extreme. Prior thrust signals become actionable.
Colour logic Fixed absolute thresholds, not percentiles. % columns graded on 0-100 with tighter bands around the 42-58% regime boundary. Count columns converted to % of universe first. Inverted so red always means bearish.
